_help: Data for the per-app privacy policy pages (privacy/<slug>.html). 'services' are the third-party SDKs used by every app unless an app lists its own 'services' under 'apps'. 'permissions' and 'on_device' add app-specific details. After editing run: python3 tools/build.py

play.name: Google Play Services
play.purpose: Core Android services the App relies on, such as installing, updating and verifying the App.

admob.name: Google AdMob
admob.purpose: Shows ads in the App and measures how ads perform. It may use your device's advertising ID, IP address and approximate location (derived from your IP address) and information about your device and ad interactions.

firebase.name: Google Analytics for Firebase
firebase.purpose: Helps us understand how the App is used (for example which screens are opened and how long sessions last), and records app errors so we can fix them. It uses an app-instance identifier and device information.

onesignal.name: OneSignal
onesignal.purpose: Sends push notifications, such as reminders and news about new content. It uses a push token and device identifier, together with device and notification-interaction information.
